snippet.title: Space Industry Trailer 1 4K
snippet.description:
In Space Industry, you build your space fleet by gathering and processing resources to expand your ships.

Add this game to your Steam wishlist.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4955960/Space_Industry/
Play the demo on September 4th!

About Space Industry
Space Industry is a 2D space automation sandbox in which players build and expand a modular spaceship, mine asteroids, automate production with drones, research new technologies and explore a galaxy filled with hostile fleets. The ultimate goal is to prepare the ship for humanity's most dangerous expedition: a journey to the black hole.

Developed by Eirikrson
